title: Jennifer Garner goes full Disney adult and fan girls over someone special - NewsBreak
text: Jennifer Garner is a Disney adult. The 53-year-old actress spent time this week at Walt Disney World, and it looked like she had a blast. The 13 Going on 30 star shared photos and videos from her day on Instagram, which included a special meeting with Daisy Duck. Garner was there to celebrate Once Upon a Farm’s new setup, and she even got behind the counter, serving some kids the products. They probably had no idea one of the most famous actresses in the world was serving them chilled pouches, which will make for a special memory when they grow up and look back at photos. The mother of three also had a fun moment meeting Fancy Nancy for the first time. “I’m such a huge fan!” Garner gushed. Nancy returned the love, fawning over Garner’s summery straw hat before the actress turned to Daisy Duck and joked, “So did Daisy!” She even had a dance number with Goofy and Pluto. “Smiles are bigger @waltdisneyworld,” she captioned her post , admitting that she was "a little bit scared" on Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind at EPCOT. The ride left her frazzled with her hair out of place as she quipped, "I don't think this guy was a very careful flier." Garner has been living her best carefree life. She recently sparked engagement rumors with John Miller after she was spotted on July 8 with what looks like a diamond ring on that special finger. But it could be a prop for the movie. Garner is very private, though, so if she is engaged, she will probably keep it a secret for a while. Garner is truly one of Hollywood's most unproblematic stars. In addition to business ventures, family time, and moments with Miller, she also speaks up about things that matter. The Yes Day star was among celebs, like Matthew McConaughey and Khloe Kardashian , who spoke up after the Texas flood tragedy. The Family Switch star was born in Houston, so it rang close to home. She kept her statement short but sweet, writing on her Instagram Story, "Texas. God, be near." Garner was also doing everything she could after the LA fires. Moral of the story: Be more like Jennifer Garner.
